name: Aluber the Jester of Despia
card_text: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Branded" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand. If a face-up Fusion Monster you control is destroyed by battle, or leaves the field because of an opponent's card effect, while this card is in your GY: You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; Special Summon this card, and if you do, negate the targeted monster's effects until the end of this turn. You can only use 1 "Aluber the Jester of Despia" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
available_set: THE CHRONICLES DECK: The Fallen & The Virtuous (All-Foil Edition)
GHOSTS FROM THE PAST: THE 2ND HAUNTING
